api.install_parent: install_parent(context_getter, source, output_dir) returns restore callback; invoke before constructing spawn pools.
api.bootstrap: Separate sitecustomize activates Finder/Recorder before spawn callable unpickling; records preexisting modules before activation.
api.events: events-PID.jsonl append-only submitted/process_start/worker_start/job_start/job_end/worker_end/untracked_activity receipts; job UUID joins parent and child.
api.snapshots: observations-PID.json cumulative Recorder snapshots, atomically replaced after each job and at finalization. Full observations, execution_codes, readers, preexisting_modules and ineligible_files preserved.
api.context: Each submitted job carries exact current parent context. Import, initializer, serialization and between-job work uses @worker-unassigned:PID; merge must expand this context to ALL worker_contexts for that PID.
api.merge: Not implemented here: union identical site/typepairs, execution-code contexts+ancestry, source/code/code_object readers and preexisting/ineligible metadata. Never overwrite one worker with another.
api.audit: audit_receipts(output_dir) requires unique job start/end, worker start/end and parseable snapshot. Gaps, unsupported process starts and observed untracked activity retain affected contexts. Returns narrowing_authorized=false.

limits: Audit hooks and Process.start interception do not prove absence of all native/untracked child activity; activity_audit_exhaustive=false.
Only ProcessPoolExecutor spawn jobs supported. Fork/forkserver/custom processes stay conservative.
Final snapshot uses multiprocessing Finalize at negative sys.maxsize priority; arbitrary later native shutdown activity is not proved observed.
Unassigned bootstrap observations/readers require transitive propagation to all worker jobs, even when initialization happened before the first job.
Instrumentation changes stacks/globals/refcounts/timing; this pilot establishes capture plumbing, not semantic transparency.
Future mergers must treat malformed/missing shards and any source/code reader gaps conservatively. No production map or selector changed.
